chunks: And ʿUmar ibn Udhaynah narrated from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two Imams, peace be upon them, who said:
I asked him about the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
Lawful to you are the grazing livestock.
So he said: "The fetus, if it has grown hair or fur, then its slaughtering is the slaughtering of its mother."

key_terms.أَوْبَرَ: it has grown fur or wool
key_terms.أُحِلَّتْ: has been made lawful or permitted
key_terms.بَهِيمَةُ الْأَنْعَامِ: the class of grazing livestock animals mentioned in the verse
key_terms.ذَكَاةُ أُمِّهِ: the slaughter of its mother, which suffices for it
key_terms.ذَكَاتُهُ: its valid slaughtering or legal purification through slaughter

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a fetus found inside a properly slaughtered animal in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the Qur'anic permissibility of livestock by clarifying a legal ruling concerning the fetus found in a slaughtered animal. If the fetus has developed hair or fur, its lawful slaughter is considered fulfilled by the slaughter of its mother.
